name: SuperDashboard
desc:
A dashboard you build yourself, opened from a floating bubble or the toolbar. Fully offline, no account.

Add the blocks you want in 1-3 columns: shortcuts, file browser, search (names, keywords, note titles), a Contents outline of the note you're in, recent files, stars, keywords, clock, device status, app launchers, Note Clips and To-dos. Your choice of design, font and text size.

Clips & To-dos: lasso anything in a note (or a PDF/EPUB annotation, or select printed PDF text) and pin it to the dashboard, labelled and linked back to its page. Paste a clip back as native ink or editable text. Tick a to-do on the note or in the dashboard.

Needs file access, no internet: READ to scan and open your files, WRITE to save settings and draw a to-do's check.

Source & updates: https://github.com/AgP42/SuperDashboard
Support: https://ko-fi.com/agp42
author: AgP42
